test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to Union Health Ministry, a new display image, with a warning written as "Tobacco causes painful death" will be printed on Tobacco products manufactured, imported, or packaged on or after __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 December 2022.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **tobacco products** made, imported, or packaged on or after** December 1, 2022,** a** new display graphic** with the warning "**Tobacco causes painful death"** will be printed, according to the** Union Health Ministry.**
 
• Until **November 30, 2022,** the **current health warning** will remain in effect.
 
• Another display graphic will be used starting on **December 1, 2023**, with the warning** "Tobacco users die Younger."** stated beneath it.
 
• The** 2008 Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products** (Packaging and Labelling) Rules have been updated by the Ministry.
 
• The public was informed of these **changes on July 21, 2022.**
 
• Any person involved directly or indirectly in the manufacture**, production, import, supply, or distribution of any tobacco products** is required to make sure that all **tobacco product packaging** has specific health warnings. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the **Global Adult Tobacco Survey (GATS) 2016-2017**, **Maharashtra** is the Indian state with the lowest prevalence of tobacco use.
 
• More than **91% of Indian smokers** think smoking causes **significant illnesses.**
 
• **10.7% of adults **in India smoke **tobacco,** compared to **28.6% of persons** who use tobacco in a smokeless or smoking form.
 
• According to Tobacco Free Union, more than **1 million people die** in India each year as a result of **tobacco-related ailments.**
